ns2:course.label: Soft Materials Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar on current research in the science and engineering of soft materials; includes presentations by visiting lecturers, staff, and students. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. A maximum of 2 hours of MSE 529, MSE 559 and MSE 590 may count toward the MatSE M.S. degree; likewise 4 hours of the MatSE Ph.D. degree.
